question: With the exact same frozen inputs, prompt, schema, validation, deterministic policy, comparator and resolver, does gpt-5.6-terra materially outperform gpt-5.6-luna?

category_rules.MATERIALLY BETTER: All six quality-retention gates pass, semantic mapping correctness is at least 47/48, and PROXY recall is at least 5/6.
category_rules.BETTER BUT NOT MATERIAL: All six quality-retention gates pass and Terra exceeds Luna's 45/48 semantic correctness and/or 3/6 PROXY recall, but does not satisfy both material-improvement gates.
category_rules.EQUIVALENT: All six quality-retention gates pass and Terra produces no meaningful accuracy advantage over Luna.
category_rules.WORSE: Terra produces lower overall evidence quality than Luna, or fails one or more quality-retention gates.
